project_info.color_palette: ivory white, soft cool gray, cool pink, nude, dark hair, and subtle silver shimmer

main_subject.detail: adult high-fashion model with dark brown hair flowing naturally from a fluffy white fur hat, natural full brows, cool rosy blush, and calm dreamy confident expression
main_subject.wardrobe: luxurious white faux-fur hat and matching white faux-fur coat framing the face
main_subject.poses: front-facing calm gaze, soft head tilt, and eyes closed while both hands gently touch the hat

composition_elements.framing: beauty portrait and upper torso in a consistent three-pose editorial series
composition_elements.background: minimal soft cool-gray studio with shallow creamy background separation
composition_elements.beauty_details: icy shimmer eyeshadow, subtle winged liner, long separated lashes, luminous natural skin, and glossy nude-to-soft-brown lips

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame cinema camera with 85mm prime, high-fashion winter film still
technical_specs.finish: controlled editorial saturation, balanced cool-neutral skin, subtle fine analog grain, and consistent face across frames

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a luxury winter couture beauty editorial series of a clearly adult woman with dark brown hair flowing naturally from under a fluffy white faux-fur hat and a matching white faux-fur coat framing her face. Use icy shimmer eyeshadow, subtle winged liner, long separated lashes, natural full brows, cool rosy blush, soft luminous natural skin, and glossy nude-to-soft-brown lips. Create three consistent poses: a front-facing calm gaze, a soft head tilt, and eyes closed while both hands gently touch the fur hat. Frame beauty portrait and upper torso against a minimal soft cool-gray studio with shallow creamy background separation. Use a full-frame cinema camera with an 85mm prime, large approximately 5000K diffused frontal light, gentle fill, subtle fur-edge rim, controlled editorial color, soft filmic highlight rolloff, and subtle fine analog grain. Preserve adult identity and outfit continuity; no logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike styling, celebrity likeness, real fur harm, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, inconsistent face, broken fur texture, flat lighting
